theme: Trao đổi với kế toán thuế

vocab.example: We need to calculate the taxable income for this quarter.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta cần tính thu nhập chịu thuế cho quý này.

vocab.example: Which tax bracket does this employee fall into?
vocab.example_vi: Nhân viên này thuộc bậc thuế nào?

vocab.example: We must deduct withholding tax before transferring the payment.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta phải khấu trừ thuế tại nguồn trước khi chuyển khoản.

vocab.example: Our tax filing is due by the 20th of next month.
vocab.example_vi: Việc kê khai thuế của chúng ta phải hoàn tất trước ngày 20 tháng sau.

vocab.example: The treaty helps us avoid double taxation on overseas income.
vocab.example_vi: Hiệp định này giúp tránh đánh thuế hai lần với thu nhập ở nước ngoài.

vocab.example: I booked a meeting with our tax advisor this afternoon.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đã đặt lịch gặp chuyên viên tư vấn thuế chiều nay.

vocab.example: We paid provisional tax based on last year's estimate.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta đã nộp thuế tạm tính dựa trên ước tính năm ngoái.

vocab.example: This isn't a tax loophole, it's a legal deduction.
vocab.example_vi: Đây không phải kẽ hở thuế, mà là khoản khấu trừ hợp pháp.

listening.title: A call with the tax advisor

lines.speaker: Huong (accountant)
lines.text: Hi Binh, thanks for joining. We need help with our taxable income calculation this quarter.

lines.speaker: Binh (tax advisor)
lines.text: Sure. Can you tell me which tax bracket most of your employees are in?

lines.speaker: Huong (accountant)
lines.text: Most are in the middle bracket, but a few might have changed.

lines.speaker: Binh (tax advisor)
lines.text: Okay. Also, don't forget to apply withholding tax before paying our overseas contractors.

lines.speaker: Huong (accountant)
lines.text: Got it. When is our tax filing due this time?

lines.speaker: Binh (tax advisor)
lines.text: It's due by the 20th of next month, no extension this year.

lines.speaker: Huong (accountant)
lines.text: Understood. What about our staff working abroad? Any double taxation risk?

lines.speaker: Binh (tax advisor)
lines.text: The treaty should cover that, but I'll double-check the details.

lines.speaker: Huong (accountant)
lines.text: Thank you. Should we also review our provisional tax payment?

lines.speaker: Binh (tax advisor)
lines.text: Yes, let's compare it with last year's estimate.

lines.speaker: Huong (accountant)
lines.text: One more thing, is this deduction a tax loophole or is it legal?

lines.speaker: Binh (tax advisor)
lines.text: It's completely legal, don't worry. As your tax advisor, I'll confirm everything in writing.
